set.body:
## Outcome and owner
Integrate mesh4s geometry smoothing as a derived, explicitly identified inflated display realization in ScalaFIM surface/surface-view. Owner: ScalaFIM surface/view maintainer. Priority P2, feature/integration; implementation not started. Keep the generic numerical kernel in mesh4s.

## Motivation and current boundary
User visual review on 2026-09-22 accepted the source-bound PLS Neuro beta/FIR image packet, with the observation that inflated surfaces look a little rough and one or two smoothing iterations might help. This is an experiment request, not an adopted default or proof of a geometry defect. First isolate mesh shape, normal shading and curvature contrast under matched views.
PLS Neuro currently derives anatomy lighting from provider-compiled display-geometry normals in ResultSurfaceView.shapeShades. SmoothWm is an existing named mesh resource, not an on-demand smoothing operation.
The inspected primary ScalaFIM checkout and current PLS Neuro provider pin still expose the earlier TriangleMesh boundary. However, completed native migration epic bd-01KYT2FD73TC4X1SC10HB5NCW3 records the mesh4s-backed candidate 84c255267078a3c7646bd9d73338c63d1ea16a19 on codex/mesh4s-surfaces with exact providers and passing courts. Inspect that candidate and current branch/adoption state before adding any adapter. Reuse the established migration; do not duplicate it or silently switch the consumer closure.

## Prerequisite and ownership
External prerequisite: the mesh4s native smoothing ticket linked in the follow-up provenance note, in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/mesh4s/.mote. Consume an exact tested revision through its public API. Keep this ticket blocked for implementation/admission until the necessary API and compatible provider closure are available; read-only diagnosis and fixture design can proceed. Do not add foreign IDs as local blocking edges.
Reuse the existing surface geometry-family and mesh4s integration contracts. Likely scope: modules/surface and modules/surface-view, their JVM/JS tests, provider dependency wiring if needed, and public examples/docs. Rendering/native proof belongs in the relevant JavaFX module. No application-local kernel or atlas/voxel resampling workaround.

## Required behavior
- Keep original mesh resources immutable. Derive only the selected inflated display coordinates from the admitted original geometry; each setting starts from that original, not repeated smoothing of a cached previous result.
- Preserve exact vertex/face correspondence, topology owner, hemisphere, surface identity and coordinate-frame/transform meaning. Retain the original anatomical sampling geometry and all mapped scalar values, missingness, thresholds and statistical provenance.
- Recompute normals from the derived display geometry as appropriate. A displayed pick must retain the original face/vertex/barycentric provenance and continue to map through the original anatomical sampling contract.
- Record algorithm/version, parameters, source geometry identity and output identity. Geometry-dependent caches and persisted viewer state must distinguish original and derived realizations. Save/reopen is deterministic; older recipes remain unchanged/unsmoothed.
- Define bounded off-UI preparation and cancellation/stale-result refusal; preserve navigation and selection when adopting the new display geometry. No remount/re-smoothing on an ordinary palette or scalar change when geometry is unchanged.
- Keep original/no smoothing available. Compare zero, one and two iterations; do not silently make any smoothing choice the default. Unsupported resources/configurations receive an explicit refusal.

## Acceptance evidence
1. Provider API tests prove unchanged original coordinates, topology/vertex IDs, mapped values, missingness and anatomical sampling outputs. Include asymmetric/synthetic meshes, boundaries, invalid settings and failure recovery.
2. Same original picks/provenance before and after display deformation; shader/material and lighting changes must not alter scientific colour identity. Geometry changes invalidate exactly the appropriate caches.
3. Persistence/reopen and rapid setting-change tests: reproduce the identified output, preserve camera/selection, reject stale work, and avoid cumulative smoothing.
4. Matched real beta/FIR original/one-/two-iteration captures at true 1x and 2x output scales; include inflated left/right lateral/medial, unlit and anatomy-lit, curvature-only, strong overlays and missing data. Keep camera, lighting and scale fixed. Obtain human preference/acceptance without inferring it from numerical tests.
5. Measure preparation/normal regeneration, upload, responsiveness and heap/process impact under the existing application envelope. Document geometric displacement/shape drift and limitations from the mesh4s receipt. No softened performance/fidelity thresholds and no GPU/resource claim from heap alone.
6. Relevant JVM/Scala.js/optimized-JS and native viewer gates from a clean exact candidate with declared provider closure. Consumer adoption is a separate exact-pin decision; no full V4 closure from this feature alone.

## Links and exclusions
Consumer polish: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/.mote bd-01M1YJNKZ6MF164N604WD8HJRY. User review record: /private/tmp/plsneuro-v4-broader-20260922/docs/verification/viewer-v4-human-review-2026-09-22.md at consumer commit 96cb12a.
This does not smooth statistical maps, deform anatomical sampling coordinates, fix stock Metal atlas fidelity, change scientific inference, or close unsupported-host fallback gates. Publication, broader mesh4s migration and default changes require their own authorized scope/evidence.
set.title: Integrate mesh4s smoothing for identified inflated display geometry
